title: AN EMPIRICAL EVALUATION OF THE IMPLEMENTATION OF THE CALIFORNIA CONSUMER PRIVACY ACT (CCPA)
reasoning: The paper's entire focus is on the empirical evaluation of the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), a law that codifies ethical principles concerning consumer data privacy. The research assesses the degree to which various organizations comply with these legally mandated ethical standards for data handling and consumer rights. This constitutes a direct evaluation of applied ethics in the corporate world.
